_comment: Shared PDF heading-classification cases, read by internal/pdf (classifyBlock with scriptWords + pageLeftMargin) and extension/src/reflow.js (classifyBlock with countWords). tag is what the block must be classified as. leadingSpaces/pageMargin are the pdftotext -layout geometry the desktop sees; the extension receives centered = leadingSpaces - pageMargin > 8, the spaces proxy of its geometric test. Script-aware word counting: a run of Han / Hiragana / Katakana counts as ceil(runes / 2) words, any other run counts as one, so Chinese and Japanese paragraphs stop being 'short'. See docs/PARITY.md, PDF reflow heuristics, and DEV/plan/73_2026-09-29_cjk-pdf-paragraphs-become-headings.md.

cases.why: a two-glyph Han heading is one word: short and centred
